set.body:
Purpose and scope
Introduce a bounded publication-intent contract identifying a completed run, its immutable receipt, publisher, explicit destination and expected base, and an idempotency key. Keep original RunSpec and ProcessingEvidence immutable. Specify owner-only publication initially, current source access, destination propose/accept powers, private-input handling, complete-output replacement, and whether multiple publications are supported. Separate publication identity from execution identity; existing begin/beginAt behavior remains compatible.

Acceptance proof
Pure contract cases reject incomplete/failed runs, changed receipts, invalid destination/base and key reuse with changed intent. Identity changes with every material publication field. Existing run IDs and historical decoding retain their meaning. Record the chosen policy and compatibility rules with the contract.

Start here
modules/kernel/src/main/scala/sanctity/kernel/ProcessingRuns.scala; Processing.scala; modules/application/src/main/scala/sanctity/application/Capabilities.scala; docs/scientific-core.md

Working agreement
Preserve the existing working-tree baseline. Use current repository contracts, keep historical identities stable, and attach actual verification commands/results before closing. Coordinate shared catalog files, profile versions and migration numbers with other work in this tranche. Planning references: docs/scientific-core.md and docs/implementation-plan.md.
set.title: P1: Define explicit publication of a completed run without rewriting execution
